description.p: Varlens is a fast, native Linux developer desktop application built with Rust, GTK4, and Libadwaita. It empowers developers to inspect, format, explore, and diff structured data efficiently:

ul.li: High-performance JSON and XML formatting with configurable indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces, tabs) and minification.
Interactive JSON Tree Explorer with collapsible nodes, live query search, and instant access path copying.
Robust Pest PEG parser for PHP var_dump() and print_r() Array raw outputs into structured JSON.
Visual Side-by-Side Diff comparator with Myers and Patience algorithms, and token-level change highlights.
Zero-lag non-blocking asynchronous processing for large payloads.
Full internationalization (i18n) with live runtime switching between English and Spanish.

screenshot.caption: Interactive Tree exploration and live node filtering
Side-by-side visual diff comparator with token highlighting
PHP var_dump and print_r raw array parser
XML inspector with syntax validation and formatting

description.p: Feature release: PHP serialize() and session support, inline Tree View decoder for escaped JSON/JWT/Base64, CLI file arguments and stdin pipe support, native PHP formatting without auto-converting to JSON, gutter error indicator, system default language detection, and cleaner unified status bars.
Maintenance patch release: standardized AppStream screenshots and metadata, Flathub distribution badge, and updated Pest dependencies.

Major visual and functional update: semantic Tree View type badges, value copying, recursive JSON key sorting, XML to JSON conversion, PHP var_export() and short array support, Diff similarity metrics, panel swap/normalize/patch export, interactive Demo loader, Light/Dark theme toggle, and smooth minimap dragging.
Initial official production release of Varlens.
